managedMethod.doc: Declares how content is aligned in the cross axis of a flex container.
Declares the flex grow factor of an item. Defaults to 1.
Declares the flex shrink factor of an item. Must be finite and non-negative.
Declares the flex wrapping behavior of a container.

managedMethod.guardMessage: Aspect ratio must be finite and positive.
managedMethod.doc: Declares the preferred aspect ratio (width divided by height) of an item. Must be finite and positive.
Declares the ending grid line of an item's columns. Negative lines count from the end.
Declares how many grid columns an item spans.
Declares the starting grid line of an item's columns. Negative lines count from the end.
Declares the column count of a grid container.
Declares the column count of a grid container with max-content maximum sizing.
Declares the column count of a grid container with min-content minimum sizing.
Declares the row count of a grid container.
Declares the row count of a grid container with max-content maximum sizing.
Declares the row count of a grid container with min-content minimum sizing.
Declares the ending grid line of an item's rows. Negative lines count from the end.
Declares how many grid rows an item spans.
Declares the starting grid line of an item's rows. Negative lines count from the end.
Declares the border style of an element. Solid is the default and applies no change.
Declares the opacity of an element, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).
Declares the bottom-left corner radius of an element.
Declares the bottom-right corner radius of an element.
Declares the top-left corner radius of an element.
Declares the top-right corner radius of an element.
Declares the blur radius of an element's box shadow, in pixels.
Declares the color of an element's box shadow. The shadow is a single layer; unset parts default to transparent, zero offset, and zero blur/spread.
Declares the pixel offset of an element's box shadow.
Declares the spread radius of an element's box shadow, in pixels.
Declares the draw visibility of an element. Hidden elements still occupy layout space.
Declares font fallback families tried in order when glyphs are missing.
Declares the font family of an element and its children.
Declares OpenType feature tags with values, such as ligatures.
Declares the font style of an element. Only normal and italic faces are exposed.
Declares the font weight of an element, from 100 (thin) to 900 (black).

managedMethod.guardMessage: Line clamp must be at least 1.
managedMethod.doc: Truncates text after the given number of lines. Must be at least 1.
Declares the horizontal text alignment within an element.
Declares the background color behind an element's text.
Declares the color of an element's underline, creating a default underline if none is set.
Truncates overflowing text with the given indicator string, such as an ellipsis.
Declares the line-wrapping behavior of text within an element.
Declares the mouse cursor shown while hovering an element.
Sets supplementary native accessibility help without changing the visible content.
Sets the native accessible name, overriding inferred control text.
Declares the stable model identity of a virtualized list item. IDs must be unique within one list; payload 0 is reserved.
Overrides the Table header background, including its scrollbar gutter. Omission uses the current theme element background.
Overrides the Table header bottom border, including its scrollbar gutter. Omission uses the current theme border variant.
Sets inherited Table header text color for labels and custom content. Omission uses the current theme muted text.
Overrides Input caret color. Omission uses the current theme accent.
Overrides Input placeholder text color. Omission uses the current theme.
Overrides Input selection background, including alpha. Omission uses the translucent theme accent.
Overrides Slider filled track color, including alpha. Omission uses the current theme accent.
Overrides Slider thumb border color, including alpha. Omission uses the current theme accent.
Overrides Slider thumb background, including alpha. Omission uses the current theme surface background.
Overrides Slider track background, including alpha. Omission uses the current theme border variant.

commands.name: to_offset
commands.doc: Scrolls to a content-space offset.

commands.name: to_top
commands.doc: Scrolls to the top.

commands.name: to_bottom
commands.doc: Scrolls to the bottom.

commands.name: to_left
commands.doc: Scrolls to the left edge, preserving the vertical offset.

commands.name: to_right
commands.doc: Scrolls to the right edge, preserving the vertical offset.

commands.name: scroll_to_item
commands.doc: Scrolls to a stable item index.

commands.name: splice
commands.doc: Preserves measurements across an insertion and removal.

commands.name: reset
commands.doc: Rebuilds native state at a new item count.

commands.name: refresh
commands.doc: Invalidates measurements for an item range.

commands.name: focus
commands.doc: Moves native keyboard focus to the input.

commands.name: blur
commands.doc: Releases native keyboard focus from the input.

commands.name: set_value
commands.doc: Replaces the input value without emitting events.

commands.name: select_all
commands.doc: Selects the whole input value.

commands.name: set_value_if_current
commands.doc: Replaces UTF-8 data without events only when a matches the nonzero native revision. Word b packs input_selection_policy in bit 0 and input_composition_policy in bit 1; other bits are reserved zero. Identical normalized values preserve editing state.

commands.name: set_value_if_current_with_result
commands.doc: Conditional UTF-8 replacement with opt-in input_write_completed delivery. Word a is the nonzero expected revision; b contains policies in bits 0-1 and a nonzero caller request ID in bits 2-63. No result is delivered after resource removal or binding retirement.

commands.name: set_value
commands.doc: Sets the slider value without emitting events.

commands.name: close_panel
commands.doc: Removes a panel natively and fires the closed event.

commands.name: set_region_open
commands.doc: Opens or collapses a side region.

commands.name: import_layout
commands.doc: Restores native structure from a layout document.

commands.name: export_layout
commands.doc: Emits the authoritative layout document.

commands.name: focus
commands.doc: Moves native keyboard focus to the declared container.

commands.name: blur
commands.doc: Releases focus only when this target itself is focused.

controlEvents.name: input_changed
controlEvents.doc: The input value changed.

controlEvents.name: input_focus_changed
controlEvents.doc: Input focus changed.

controlEvents.name: input_submitted
controlEvents.doc: The input value was submitted.

controlEvents.name: input_write_completed
controlEvents.doc: Opt-in conditional write result. Payload: u64 request ID (1..2^62-1), u32 input_write_outcome, zero u32 reserved, all little-endian. Revision is the nonzero native revision at decision time; flags are zero. Delivered after native borrows are released, while the event binding remains live.

controlEvents.name: list_activated
controlEvents.doc: Opt-in item activation. Data is 16 little-endian bytes: u32 index, zero u32 reserved, u64 ItemId (zero when absent). Flags bit 0 selects keyboard instead of pointer, bit 1 indicates a datasource content revision in revision; all other bits are zero. Without bit 1, revision is zero.

controlEvents.name: list_context_menu_requested
controlEvents.doc: Right-click on an item with a stable ItemId. Carries the 16-byte item identity packet followed by a nonzero U64 native anchor. Only flag 1 (content revision present) is allowed.

controlEvents.name: list_selection_requested
controlEvents.doc: Opt-in single-item selection request. Uses the List Activated payload and flag layout; selection and presentation remain application-owned.

controlEvents.name: list_tooltip_requested
controlEvents.doc: Delayed hover on a marked item element with stable ItemId. Uses the Item ContextMenu 24-byte identity/anchor packet and revision flag. No pointer motion crosses the ABI.

controlEvents.name: slider_changed
controlEvents.doc: The slider value changed during interaction.

controlEvents.name: slider_released
controlEvents.doc: The slider interaction released.

controlEvents.name: dock_layout_changed
controlEvents.doc: Coarse structural signal. Fires for native interaction and for declarative or controller-driven structural changes. Carries no payload; debounce with the event revision.

controlEvents.name: dock_layout_exported
controlEvents.doc: Carries the exported layout document requested through the controller.

controlEvents.name: dock_panel_closed
controlEvents.doc: A panel left the Dock natively or through the controller. Carries the panel id. Panels removed by declaration or pruned by layout import do not fire this event.

controlEvents.name: key_down
controlEvents.doc: A key was pressed while the bound element had focus or the event bubbled to it. Carries the UTF-8 key name; flags hold modifiers and the held-repeat bit. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: key_up
controlEvents.doc: A key was released while the bound element had focus or the event bubbled to it. Carries the UTF-8 key name; flags hold modifiers. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: mouse_down
controlEvents.doc: A mouse button was pressed over the bound element. Carries x, y, button, and click count; flags hold modifiers. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: mouse_down_out
controlEvents.doc: A mouse button was pressed outside the bound element. Same payload as mouse down. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: mouse_move
controlEvents.doc: The mouse moved over the bound element. Carries x, y, and the pressed button (none when empty); flags hold modifiers. High-frequency: only published while bound, and handlers must stay cheap. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: mouse_up
controlEvents.doc: A mouse button was released over the bound element. Carries x, y, button, and click count; flags hold modifiers. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: mouse_up_out
controlEvents.doc: A mouse button was released outside the bound element. Same payload as mouse up. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: modifiers_changed
controlEvents.doc: Modifier keys changed while the bound element had focus or the event bubbled to it. Carries no payload; flags hold the current modifiers. This is the only event for modifier-only presses, which never produce key events. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: hover
controlEvents.doc: Hover state changed over the bound element. Carries no payload; flags hold modifiers in bits 0-4 and the hovering state in bit 5. Fires on enter/exit transitions only, never per move. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: scroll_wheel
controlEvents.doc: The scroll wheel moved over the bound element. Carries x, y, delta x/y, and pixel/line units; flags hold modifiers. High-frequency: only published while bound, and handlers must stay cheap. Does not replace retained Scroll resources. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: file_dropped
controlEvents.doc: OS files were dropped onto the bound element. Carries x, y followed by NUL-separated UTF-8 paths (lossy); flags hold modifiers. Only published while bound. Observers only: never stops propagation.

controlEvents.name: shortcut_invoked
controlEvents.doc: Matched native shortcut. Empty payload, flags and revision zero; callback owns command behavior.
